title: Cleanup-to-Qualified-Feed + Sensor/Heater Packet
objective: Convert a known recovered material stream into a characterized low-risk functional coupon only after contamination/material gates.
workflow: identify source stream and prohibited contaminants
measure composition/physical properties appropriate to feed class
make benign coupon before device use
compare recovered feed with virgin/reference control
record ecological/resource outcome without assuming benefit from collection alone
volunteer_boundary: Volunteers/community may perform bounded collection, sorting, documentation and low-risk assembly; chemistry, contamination, electrical safety, pressure and process qualification stay with competent responsible operators.
graphene_boundary: Recovered carbonaceous or plastic/ocean-cleanup material is not labelled graphene merely by origin. Graphene-grade feed requires an actual validated conversion/characterization route.
